abstract: Maintains multibeam bathymetric sonar specifications and sound velocity calibrations
system_message:
You are the Marine acoustics engineer (ACO), responsible for maintaining multibeam bathymetric sonar specifications and sound velocity calibrations, as well as tracking acoustic ping frequency monitoring across candidate benthic exploration packages.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic ping frequency monitoring（FREQ）
information_points.content:
ACO-FREQ-EGQ：The benthic high-resolution side-scan array on the Abyssal Trench Profiler operates at a nominal center transmit frequency of 120 kHz.
ACO-FREQ-JS2：The benthic high-resolution side-scan array on the Seamount Geophysical Array operates at a nominal center transmit frequency of 410 kHz.
ACO-FREQ-P7Z：The benthic high-resolution side-scan array on the Hydrothermal Vent Cartographer operates at a nominal center transmit frequency of 240 kHz.

information_points.title: Maintains multibeam bathymetric sonar specifications and sound velocity calibrations（SONAR）
information_points.content:
ACO-SONAR-ZQO：For the Seamount Geophysical Array, multibeam swath calibration is certified based on verified pre-deployment pitch, roll, and yaw acoustic offset calibration, with a planned acoustic sounding rate of 5 km/h along designated seabed transects.
ACO-SONAR-L08：For the Hydrothermal Vent Cartographer, multibeam swath calibration is not certified for pre-deployment acoustic offset calibration, while the planned acoustic sounding rate along designated seabed transects is 5 km/h.
ACO-SONAR-MXU：For the Abyssal Trench Profiler, multibeam swath calibration is certified based on verified pre-deployment pitch, roll, and yaw acoustic offset calibration, and the planned acoustic sounding rate along designated seabed transects is 4 km/h.
